name: web-a11y
description: Playwright-based accessibility audit reports and axe remediation workflows for web application URLs across React, Next.js, Spring/Thymeleaf, and static HTML.

interface.shortDescription: Audit web URLs and fix axe findings
interface.longDescription: Run Playwright and axe-core accessibility audits against rendered web URLs, produce JSON plus Markdown reports, and guide focused remediation of actionable findings while requiring confirmation before color-contrast changes.
defaultPrompt: Run an accessibility audit for this URL.
Audit these web pages and write JSON and Markdown reports.
Summarize the latest Playwright accessibility audit report.
Fix actionable axe findings from this accessibility report.
